mapper.select: SELECT art.id, art.id_site, art.status, art.pause_reason, art.notes, DATE_FORMAT(art.modified_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS modified_date, art.modified_by, CONCAT_WS(' ', e.first_name, e.last_name) AS modified_by_name FROM analytical_report_tracker art LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = art.modified_by WHERE art.id = #{id} AND art.id_site = #{id_site} LIMIT 1

SELECT art.id, art.id_site, art.status, art.pause_reason, art.notes, DATE_FORMAT(art.modified_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS modified_date, art.modified_by, CONCAT_WS(' ', e.first_name, e.last_name) AS modified_by_name FROM analytical_report_tracker art LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = art.modified_by WHERE art.id_site = #{id_site} ORDER BY art.modified_date DESC, art.id DESC LIMIT 1
